sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for sharing the cost background; we understand that input costs have risen, and appreciate your established relationship with us. We have fixed our full demand for this part with you, and the longer contract term offers planning security as our forecasted demand is rising. Since you bought material forward at fixed prices, could the alloy surcharge and base price reflect that position? We’d also welcome the calculation walkthrough your owner previously offered.

Your quote of 2026-09-10 for this part was EUR 5.45 per unit ("Material covered until March 2027; price valid accordingly") (quote:7300008).
We currently buy this part from another supplier at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
The price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We appreciate the prospect of a 36-month agreement and have adjusted our offer to EUR 5.57 per unit to reflect the extended term and 90-day payment period.
Please note that for a contract of this length, we cannot maintain a fixed price and must include the AS-14404 index clause.
Furthermore, we kindly ask you to provide verifiable proof of the alternative pricing, as the referenced orders appear to relate to a different part.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing our proposal and moving your offer; we appreciate that, and understand the need to account for material and other cost drivers, as well as the limits on sharing more detail. We note your concern about the comparisons cited, and the supporting data follows below; our order volume covers our full demand for this part over the term, and our rising forecast and long-term commitment offer planning security. We have moved our proposal toward you again, with the full terms set out below.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.82 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 0.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Our terms: a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which is essential for a 36-month agreement.
In response to your movement, we can adjust our offer to EUR 5.41 per unit for this package.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
